ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white pigmentation concentrated in the distal and mid-lobe regions, characterized by dense black mottling and linear interruptions; the central region adjacent to the median notch is characterized by a solid low-intensity black mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 68 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile consisting of numerous sharp peaks and narrow valleys ranging from 5 to 25 pixels in amplitude across the entire trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edge with an upward distal sweep; the trailing edge maintains a wide, broadly horizontal orientation relative to the horizon line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several distinct circular and annular low-intensity rings (approximately 15-25 pixels in diameter) localized in the mid-black regions of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned linear pixel disruptions; prominent diagonal and horizontal high-contrast scratches are visible across both the white and black pigmented regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular calcified clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, resulting in a distinctively rough, high-intensity texture compared to the smooth fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical and sub-vertical parallel 'rake' marks on the left lobe, intersecting with a high density of fine-line scratches across the lateral surfaces.
